cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. My tea's stronger than yours. I can handle it without milk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same teapot. I added milk so I could drink mine sooner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. First to finish, then. I've only got two mouthfuls left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fewest refills wins, then. I can make these two mouthfuls last all breakfast.

mechanism: A uses its claimed tea education to judge itself superior and changes the competitive measure when B wins.
confusable: It is competitive self-protection, not just correcting a pupil taste.
comparison: Food preference with biased judging versus tea consumption with a changing finish line.
seedUse: Preserve D19 milk-speed-refill sequence, but S05 lessons in patience and efficiency become the criteria A owns.
